diagnosis: The checks C2 and C3 passed because the lone decision-maker set the initial rollout percentage to 5% and the cache TTL to 3600 seconds, which aligns with the default values for PF2 and PF1 respectively. This allowed the checks to pass without needing the hidden information.

C2.why: PF2 changes the initial cohort to exactly 10 percent or a coordinated hold, and explicitly changes the cache lifetime to exactly 300 seconds rather than the 9-minute propagation measurement.

C3.why: The passing tests do not expose the 23 legacy endpoints, and PF1 changes the plan from ordinary cache enablement to either enabling the adapter or recording a binding commitment to build and verify it before expanding the rollout.
